title: First opposite runs at powers of two in two prime races
description:
On the 547/727 and 571/599 fields the first exact power-of-two start for two gains on the former and two losses on the latter is 2^34. Reversing the fields gives 2^12. Each change strictly exceeds 1.9735 log 2 in its prescribed direction. Two independent prime sieves through norm 2^38 certify the complete first-occurrence table through exponent 34 for every nonnegative margin. Fourteen words occur and 23 records are controlled by sixteen margins linearly independent together with 1 over the real algebraic numbers. These are unconditional results. The retained infinite six-step recurrence uses GRH for sixteen primitive Dirichlet functions.

First-exponent proof and independent arithmetic checks.
